text: Nvidia agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B, adding its open-source AI platform to Nvidia's existing compute infrastructure. Hugging Face will remain open to the broader AI ecosystem. The transaction is Nvidia's second-largest acquisition.

meta.note: The announced open-platform structure preserves ecosystem access within Nvidia's ownership.

text: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said he is inclined to hold rates steady in September if incoming inflation data remain supportive. His position differs from Chair Kevin Warsh's tighter stance. Market-implied September hike odds fell to 48.4%.

meta.note: Waller's hold position remains conditional on inflation data due before the meeting.

text: Adobe named Anil Chakravarthy president and CEO effective Dec. 1, succeeding Shantanu Narayen after 18 years as CEO. Narayen will become executive chair during the transition. Creativity and productivity president David Wadhwani will leave the company.

meta.note: CEO authority transfers Dec. 1 while Narayen retains a separate executive-chair role.

text: Lululemon reported quarterly revenue down 4% and comparable sales down 9%. FY revenue guidance fell to $10.35B-$10.5B from $11B-$11.15B. Interim CEO Meghan Frank remains in place until incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill assumes the role next week.

meta.note: Reported gross-margin expansion includes a $134.5M tariff refund, separating margin movement from revenue contraction.
